subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC org & network kickoff
messages:
From: Sam Hughes <sam@medframe.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@medframe.io>, MedFrame Procurement <procurement@medframe.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & POC network requirements

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. Procurement asked me to capture a short MAP so we can align on what we need to get the POC running in our environment. High level constraints from our side:

- We'd like the POC to run in us-west-2.
- Primary connectivity: VPC peering preferred, fallback to IP allowlist if peering needs more approvals.
- We require Org-level setup (SSO plus admin user), API keys scoped to a single POC tenant, and token rotation guidance.
- Security team needs SOC2 evidence and a short runbook for logs/audit.
- Procurement target: signed MSA and SOW within 4 weeks; they asked for a checklist to attach to the purchase request.

Can you send a short MAP with owners, dates, and the minimal network steps so our infra team can start lining up a ticket? I attached our procurement timeline and a rough network diagram.

Thanks,
Sam Hughes
Solutions Architect, MedFrame
Attachments: medframe_procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf), medframe_network_v1.png (png)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Hughes <sam@medframe.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, MedFrame Procurement <procurement@medframe.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & POC network requirements

Hi Sam — great to get this moving. Attached is a one-page MAP checklist and a preliminary tech runbook (see map_checklist.xlsx and network_diagram.png). Below is a condensed MAP with owners and target dates tailored to your procurement window. If that looks good we can convert this to a shared Google Sheet and lock in dates.

Mutual Action Plan (POC) — MedFrame x Redwood
Owners: Jonas Weber (Redwood AE), Laura Bennett (Redwood Solutions Engineer), Sam Hughes (MedFrame SA), Aisha Khan (MedFrame IT), MedFrame Procurement
Target close: 2025-07-08 (MSA + SOW signed) — aligns with your 4-week target

Critical path items (minimal set to start POC):
1) Org & Admin setup — Owner: Jonas
   - Create POC tenant org and invite 2 admin users (SSO to follow).
   - Deliverable: org invitation + onboarding doc.
   - Target: 2025-06-12

2) API keys & scoped credentials — Owner: Laura
   - Generate one scoped API key tied to POC tenant; provide rotation instructions and TTL recommendations.
   - Deliverable: key stub + rotation checklist.
   - Target: 2025-06-13

3) Network connectivity (Preferred: VPC peering) — Owner: Vivek / MedFrame IT
   - Exchange VPC CIDR and project IDs.
   - Redwood to provide peering instructions and BGP/NAT considerations for us-west-2.
   - Fallback: provide IP allowlist ranges for quick firewall rules.
   - Deliverable: peering template + allowlist (if needed).
   - Target: 2025-06-18 (peering) / 2025-06-12 (allowlist)

4) Security compliance evidence — Owner: Jonas (coord)
   - Provide SOC2 summary page, data retention details, and audit log access plan.
   - Deliverable: medframe_soc2_request.pdf + runbook link.
   - Target: 2025-06-15

5) Procurement & Legal — Owner: MedFrame Procurement / Jonas
   - Circulate MSA + SOW; review redlines.
   - Target: sign by 2025-07-08

Notes / Technical constraints:
- If peering approval takes >5 business days, use allowlist to unblock development (lower trust but faster).
- API key scope will be limited to POC tenant and will not have access to other customers.

Next steps: Sam — confirm that the dates above are acceptable and provide the VPC CIDR + preferred contact for your network engineers. I can set a 30-minute tech sync later this week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0132
Attachments: map_checklist.xlsx (xlsx), network_diagram.png (png)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Hughes <sam@medframe.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & POC network requirements

Hi Sam — quick technical supplements to Jonas' MAP:

- VPC peering notes: Redwood will request a peering from our infra in us-west-2 once you share the VPC ID and main CIDR. Peering will be non-transitive; please confirm whether you need cross-account routing or a transit gateway.

- IP allowlist: we'll provide a minimal set of egress IPv4 ranges you can add to security groups/firewalls. These are intended for the control plane endpoints only (not recommended for high-volume data transfers).

- If you prefer a faster path for initial testing, we can create a short-lived API key and a tandem route using private endpoints + allowlist. That lets you validate integration before peering is complete.

Action items for your infra team (Aisha / networks):
1) Share VPC ID, CIDR, preferred peering contact (name + email) — needed by 2025-06-12 to hit the peering target.
2) If peering isn't approved, add the provided allowlist to your firewall by 2025-06-12.

I'll include a short README in the shared Drive with exact commands for peering and sample terraform snippets (will upload after the sync).

Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & POC network requirements

Thanks — this looks actionable and aligns with procurement. Quick confirmations from our side:

- VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d (us-west-2), CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16. Peering contact: Aisha Khan (aisha.khan@medframe.io).
- Procurement: we'll try to return the signed MSA by 2025-07-03 (earlier than planned) if redlines are minimal.
- Security: SOC2 summary was received by our security team; they asked for the audit runbook URL (can you add that to the shared drive?).

Next immediate step: please provide the allowlist ranges so our firewall team can open controls while peering approval is underway. Also — can we schedule a technical walk tomorrow (12:30 PM PT)? Aisha and I will join.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sam Hughes
Solutions Architect, MedFrame
